findings.evidence: `def mellinMoment (f) (n) ... := ∫ x in Set.Icc 0 1, x ^ n * f i x Q2` (Basic.lean:35); `gottfriedModel` densities are `(Icc 0 1).indicator (x⁻¹ + c)` (Gottfried.lean:228-234); the file's own `not_intervalIntegrable_gottfriedModel_antiquark_u` is about plain integrability, i.e. the n=0 moment.
findings.fix: Replace "first moment" with "zeroth moment" (or "is not integrable on the unit interval") in all three places, matching `Fragmentation/MomentumSumRule.lean:46`, which already says "zeroth moment `∫₀¹ dz D(z)` diverges".
findings.issue: "a sea that rises like `1/x` at small `x` has no first moment" is false in the repo's indexing: `mellinMoment f 1 = ∫ x·f`, and for `1/x` that is `∫₀¹ 1 dx = 1`. What diverges is the zeroth moment `mellinMoment f 0 = ∫ f`. Same error at line 227 ("The densities themselves have no first moment") and lines 295-296 ("no antiquark density of the model has a first moment") — every species of `gottfriedModel` has `x·(x⁻¹ + c) = 1 + c x`, which is integrable, so all three first moments exist.

findings.evidence: `valenceNumber` def at ChargeConjugation.lean:159-160; `valenceNumber_eq_intervalIntegral` (line 210) needs interval integrability of each density, which `not_intervalIntegrable_gottfriedModel_antiquark_u` (Gottfried.lean:281) refutes for this model.
findings.fix: In the `gottfriedModel` docstring say the nonsinglet differences integrate to `2`, `1` and `0` on `[0,1]`, and note explicitly that `PDF.valenceNumber` vanishes here because the individual zeroth moments do not exist; in line 181-182 phrase the hypotheses as `∫₀¹ (q − qbar) = 2` and `= 1` rather than as `valenceNumber`.
findings.issue: `gottfriedModel`'s docstring states "the valence numbers are `2`, `1` and `0`". `PDF.valenceNumber f i Q2 = mellinMoment f 0 (.quark i) Q2 - mellinMoment f 0 (.antiquark i) Q2`, and for this model both zeroth moments are integrals of non-integrable functions, hence `0`; so `valenceNumber (gottfriedModel a) i Q2 = 0` for every flavour, not 2 and 1. The file proves only the interval integrals of the differences (lines 248-264). The same conflation appears in the hypothesis description of `gottfriedSum_charge_quarkAddAntiquark` (line 181-182, "a proton whose up and down valence numbers are `2` and `1`"), whose hypotheses are `∫₀¹ (q − qbar)`, not `PDF.valenceNumber` — precisely the distinction the model exists to exhibit.

summary: Module and declaration docstrings are otherwise accurate and well-scoped, but they call the diverging integral of gottfriedModel its "first moment" (it is the zeroth moment that diverges; the n=1 moments exist), and claim the model has valence numbers 2, 1, 0 when PDF.valenceNumber of that model is 0 at every flavour.
